patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero layout with a large text block on the left and a cluster of rounded-square profile images on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.

Strategic use of vibrant, distinct accent colors (purple, teal, red, green) for background elements within the dark theme, particularly for profile images and subtle graphic elements, providing visual anchors.
Clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings contrasting with smaller, legible body text and very small, often uppercase, labels for categories or metadata.
A horizontal progress bar animates to fill as the user scrolls past the hero section, indicating progress through a 'Featured case study' section.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-in effect as they enter the viewport, creating a smooth content flow.
Consistent use of wide content columns with generous vertical spacing between major sections, contributing to an airy and uncluttered feel despite the dark background.

technique_notes: Implement a sticky navigation bar that remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Create a scroll-triggered animation system where content sections fade and slide upwards into view as they become visible in the viewport.

Design the hero section with a split layout: a prominent text block on one side and a dynamic cluster of rounded-square images on the other, each image set against a distinct, vibrant background color.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, bold sans-serif headings (~2.5-3x body) with smaller, legible body text and very small uppercase labels (~0.6x body).
design_tokens.radius: rounded for buttons and image containers, subtle for cards and section elements.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with generous vertical padding between major sections and balanced spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark background contrasted with vibrant, almost neon accent colors for specific graphic elements, particularly the rounded profile images in the hero, creates a sophisticated yet energetic visual identity. The animated horizontal progress bar for the 'Featured case study' also adds a unique interactive touch.
